researchIterations.summary: Main thread verified official inventory and GPX/API baseline. HÖ20 GPX has 453 trackpoints, one segment, 15.345074 km, start 57.53824/14.27462, end 57.53290/14.13977, six gaps over 100 m, one gap over 200 m, duplicate starting coordinate, HÖ19-HÖ20 gap 1.262 m, HÖ20-HÖ21 gap 1.194 m and direct GPX available while .kml/.geojson/.json variants were unavailable.

Required six-lane HÖ20 research completed. No second targeted batch was needed because remaining issues are import/normalization caveats: Hok bus-stop coordinate, connector length/name contradictions, Sandsjön subfacility coordinates, Byarum water tap verification, Gärahovs side-loop scoping, OSM relation divergence, dynamic fire status and Storm Dave currentness.

importReadiness.summary: HÖ20 has navigation-grade official GPX/API v2 geometry, strong endpoint continuity with HÖ19 and HÖ21, high-confidence shared endpoints at Hok/Hook herrgård and Byarum, useful access research, coordinate-backed Sandsjön/Byarum/Gärahovs facilities, and sufficient six-lane coverage. Main caveats are the approximate Hok Hooks herrgård bus-stop coordinate, Hok station connector distance conflict, Byarum church connector naming/topology, Byarum water/cafe seasonality, Sandsjön subfacility coordinate verification, suppressing unverified informal campsites, Gärahovs side-loop rule scoping, OSM relation divergence, dynamic fire-ban status and Storm Dave windthrow currentness.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Hook/Hok, HÖ20 heads west through Vaggeryd countryside toward Byarum. Early in the stage, a short side trip reaches Sandsjön's bathing place and shelter, while the Byarum end offers parking, bus access via the church connector, seasonal hembygdsgård services and nearby Gärahovs storäng. Use the official GPX as the route source, treat connector and side-loop geometry separately, and verify fire-ban, windthrow and seasonal service status before publication.
importReadiness.recommendedNextStep: Continue Höglandsleden research with HÖ21 Byarum-Skillingaryd. Do not normalize or import runtime data until the full research phase is reviewed and import is explicitly requested.
